<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Confirmation icon -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="151" r="57" fill="#AA7455" opacity="0.12"/>

  <polyline points="174,151 188,165 218,134" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="151" r="48" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Confirmation copy -->
  <text x="195" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#282C3F">Order Placed!</text>
  <text x="195" y="273" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Thank you, Amelia. Your order is confirmed.</text>
  <text x="195" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">We’ll let you know when it’s on its way.</text>

  <!-- Order summary card shadow -->
  <rect x="24" y="321" width="342" height="126" rx="16" fill="#808080" opacity="0.12"/>
  <rect x="24" y="319" width="342" height="126" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <text x="346" y="347" text-anchor="end" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#AA7455">#RX-48291</text>
  <rect x="44" y="363" width="58" height="58" rx="8" fill="#F2F1F1"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="375" r="5" fill="#AA7455"/>

  <text x="346" y="490" text-anchor="end" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#AA7455">Jun 18–20, 2026</text>

  <line x1="56" y1="523" x2="68" y2="523" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <text x="90" y="545" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">128 Mercer Street, New York, NY</text>
  <line x1="44" y1="564" x2="346" y2="564" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-opacity="0.1"/>
  <text x="44" y="583" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#AA7455">Free insured delivery</text>
  <polyline points="335,577 341,583 347,577" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <text x="44" y="628" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#282C3F">Order status</text>
  <text x="346" y="628" text-anchor="end" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#736E6E">Confirmed</text>

  <text x="340" y="669" text-anchor="end" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Delivered</text>

  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="750" width="328" height="42" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="776" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#AA7455">Continue Shopping</text>

  <rect x="0" y="800" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <line x1="346" y1="810" x2="354" y2="818" stroke="#736E6E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="810" x2="346" y2="818" stroke="#736E6E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
